characters.name: Maren Cole
characters.description: A daring sailor who hears warnings in the tide. She is looking for a ship that vanished years ago.

characters.name: Nico Reed
characters.description: A dockside fixer with friends in every tavern. He can find anything, provided you do not ask where it came from.

characters.name: Orla Vane
characters.description: A lighthouse keeper devoted to an impossible beacon. Every night, she waits for a light beyond the horizon.

characters.name: Perrin Crow
characters.description: A retired pirate who claims to have buried every treasure he stole. His map collection tells a different tale.

characters.name: Quinn Hale
characters.description: A fisher who knows the reefs better than any chartmaker. Their calm vanishes whenever the sea turns green.

characters.name: Rosa Lynn
characters.description: A bright-eyed apprentice mage fascinated by storms. She is convinced lightning has a language of its own.
